violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener relocated to the 3 bay sink to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
